title: Radiation Assessment and Dose Adjustment in Interventional Cardiology with Artifical In-telligence
summary:
Vascular examinations and treatments (angiographies) are extremely important in medicine, but they use X-rays. To protect patients and medical staff, the principle in medicine is: as little radiation as possible, but exactly as much as necessary to obtain a good image.

New technologies now make these examinations significantly safer:

A new X-ray system (ARTIS VE50 with OPTIQ) adapts automatically. No matter how large the patient is or from what angle the X-ray is taken, the system automatically selects the perfect settings. This ensures that the image remains clearly visible at all times, while significantly reducing radiation exposure (especially to the skin).

Aid from Artificial Intelligence (AI): Normally, less radiation results in a grainy or blurry image (image noise). This is where AI comes in. It functions like a digital filter that removes the noise from the images and sharpens important details.

Conclusion: Thanks to intelligent technology and AI, doctors can now work with significantly less harmful X-ray radiation and still obtain crystal-clear images for safe diagnosis and treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Age ≥ 18 years
• Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
• Lack of written informed consent
• Pregnancy or breastfeeding
• Age < 18 years
• Significant language barrier
• Current participation in another cardiology intervention study
